principles: Gate-consumed degraded fallback eligibility must be mechanically proven, not inferred from prose.
Canonical host availability is local diagnostic evidence only; it must never imply Authority or production completion.
Fail closed when host proof is missing, stale, or contradicts single-host scarcity.
drivers: User found codex, claude, and agy on PATH after a degraded fallback had claimed only one host was available.
Existing fallback records are consumed by DONE review escalation and review assurance floor gates.
Implementation should remain small and testable without building the entire cross-host runner.

options.name: A: Add a review_host_availability_probe command and require its fresh event for non-human degraded fallback
pros: Creates a durable process event that gates can consume
Keeps probing reusable for status diagnostics and user transcripts
Allows explicit-human-approval to remain a separate lower-assurance path
cons: Adds one new CLI command and process fact registration

options.name: B: Inline command -v checks inside review_escalation_fallback_set only
cons: DONE/status evaluators still cannot independently reject stale or missing proof
No durable evidence artifact for audit

options.name: C: Remove degraded fallback entirely
cons: Breaks documented policy for temporary host unavailability and explicit human approval

chosen: A: Add a review_host_availability_probe command and require its fresh event for non-human degraded fallback
rationale: Option A matches the Proof-or-stop two-layer contract: prompt/operator guidance points to the probe, while handler/evaluator gates consume a structured process fact. It fixes the current false-degraded path without overbuilding automatic cross-host review.

preMortem.scenario: Probe records only prose or evidenceRefs instead of actual command results
preMortem.trigger: The implementation accepts user-supplied host availability arrays without running command lookups
preMortem.consequence: The same self-report bug persists under a new field name
preMortem.mitigation: Handler runs command lookup/version probes itself and records path/version/error per canonical host

preMortem.scenario: Fallback set blocks but DONE status still accepts old fallback records
preMortem.trigger: Only review_escalation_fallback_set is changed while evaluateReviewEscalation/evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor keep accepting legacy records
preMortem.consequence: Existing or manually injected events can still satisfy DONE with no host proof
preMortem.mitigation: Add evaluator-level fallback validation requiring fresh probe for single-host-environment and temporary-host-unavailability

preMortem.scenario: A machine with codex and claude available still passes single-host fallback
preMortem.trigger: Availability predicate counts host verdict labels instead of executable host CLIs, or treats agy-only fallback incorrectly
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke tests inject process events/probe results proving >=2 executable canonical hosts reject single-host eligibility and <2 permits it
